free.label: Free only
free.description: Never spends money. Free models are slower and rate-limited.

newRun.cap: Cost cap for this run (USD, optional)
newRun.capHint: Paid calls stop at this amount; the run continues on free models.

runs.title: Runs
runs.emptyDescription: Start the pipeline on a research topic; you approve each stage before the next one.
runs.caption: Runs of this project
runs.shown: {shown} of {total, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}}
runs.partial: Search and filters cover the runs loaded so far.

members.title: Members
members.description: People who can see this project.
members.descriptionOwner: Add people with the email they were invited with.
members.descriptionManage: Change roles, remove people, or add someone by the email they were invited with.
members.readOnly: Only project owners and lab admins can change who is in this project.
members.addDescription: They need an account first: a lab admin invites people to the lab.

roleHints.owner: Manages members and can approve any run.
roleHints.researcher: Starts runs and approves their own.
roleHints.viewer: Can look, but cannot start or approve runs.

members.lastOwner: A project needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
members.removeDescription: They will no longer see this project or its runs. Runs they started stay in the project.
members.leaveDescription: You will no longer see this project. An owner can add you again later.
members.stepDownDescription: You will no longer be able to manage members or settings of this project.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: How runs in this project use models and approvals.
settings.descriptionReadOnly: How runs in this project use models and approvals.
settings.readOnly: Only project owners and lab admins can change these settings.

standard.label: Standard
standard.description: Any approved provider can be used, including free models that may keep prompts.

confidential.label: Confidential
confidential.description: Only providers that keep no data are used, so fewer free models are available.

allowFreeModels.label: Allow free models
allowFreeModels.description: Runs may use free models when paid ones are not available or not wanted.

autoApprove.label: Approve stages automatically
autoApprove.description: Stage outputs are approved as soon as they are ready, without waiting for a person.
autoApprove.codingNote: The coding stage is never approved automatically: a person always reviews generated code.

expiry.label: Approval expiry
expiry.hint: An output nobody decides on within this many days ({min} to {max}) cancels its run.

approvalExpiryDays.invalid: Enter a whole number of days between {min} and {max}.

budget.title: My LLM budget
budget.noBudget: No paid budget: your runs use free models.
budget.resets: Resets on the 1st of each month (UTC). When it runs out, runs switch to free models.
